description: Dispositions for rule pairs in different chapters that quote the same printed text (scripts/graph/duplicates.ts ruleRepeats, issue #4 items 22-23). A pair the PDF presents as a summary or reminder becomes a summary_of edge in corpus/graph/ and leaves the list. Every remaining pair needs exactly one entry; an entry whose pair is gone fails the test. disposition: legitimate_repeat (both kept, with the reason) or error (fixed, then removed).

entries.reason: PDF 197 prints "Remember that potions must be identified if found before drinking. That is not necessary if the potion is a result of your own mixing." on the Potions tables; the mixing rule cites PDF 197 because mixing rolls on those tables and carries the same reminder. Neither rule summarises the other; both remind of identification (section.alchemy.identifying_potions).

Same PDF 197 reminder as the random-mix pair: the recipe branch of mixing and the Potions tables both carry "Remember that potions must be identified if found before drinking." Neither summarises the other.

Creating Your Character (PDF 29) and Weapon Class (PDF 51) print the same weapon-class paragraph almost word for word ("whilst"/"whereas"); "As mentioned before" points back to the Strength stat, not to PDF 51. The weapon-class rules already cite PDF 29 as a second source. No printed summary marker, no difference in effect.
As for one_hand: the PDF 29 paragraph repeats the PDF 51 Weapon Class text and both are cited; no printed summary marker.

overlap_uncertain is an exception record that quotes the 95-00 parry, 00 fumble and magic-weapon 00 dissipation texts it arbitrates (PDF 120, 112, 70); quoting dissipation is how it states the overlap, not a second statement of the rule.

Each guild chapter prints its own training offer with the same +3 for 300 c, one session per skill between two dungeons; the skills offered differ per guild (PDF 151, 153, 154, 156, 158). No passage presents one as a summary of another, and each record owns its own guild.

The Wizards’ Guild (PDF 153) restates Learn a Spell or Prayer (PDF 146) for wizards and adds "Each hero may learn one spell in between each quest". Neither passage says it summarises the other; both are kept with their own wording.

The Combat action list (PDF 110) and Healing in Into the Dungeons (PDF 100) each print the bandage-an-adjacent-hero action. The Combat text adds "if you succeed with a Healing Roll" and "either of the two heroes"; the Into the Dungeons text adds the 1 AP cost. Neither marks itself as a summary and the two are compatible, so both stay.
